areas.label: Report
areas.instruction: Upload your report as a PDF or DOCX file. This is just a single file, so please ensure it is in the correct format.

areas.label: AMPL Code
areas.instruction: Upload a single ZIP containing your AMPL .mod/.dat/.run files. If you have multiple models, please include them all in the ZIP. Ensure that your main model file is named 'model.mod' and your data file is named 'data.dat'.
